summary: The v1 numerical bounds, eleven-stage handoff, regional transfer and promised-reachable sticker composition are sound. One major quantifier finding CF-01 requires distinguishing total finite geometric admission on G0 from complete synthesis, whose lattice theorem requires reachable inputs. No architecture acceptance or global entrance coverage is claimed.

findings.title: Separate total admission from promised-domain synthesis
findings.detail: Lines27-29 describe construction after a geometric match and then assert that the algorithm terminates on every input in the generated universe. The lattice construction is proved only for reachable inputs. Finite geometric entrance predicates alone do not make that promised constructor total on unpromised inputs. Likewise geometric acceptance is exactly D[k] only within the reachable-input promise. Restrict whole-constructor termination to promised-reachable inputs and retain totality for admission, or provide explicit bounded synthesis and a failure outcome.
findings.suggested_experiment: No geometry experiment is needed. Correct the totality/promise statement or explicitly totalize synthesis by a finite certified search; then perform one scoped text verification.
